verdict.rationale: Batch conversion is a fair question for a media-conversion CLI, but the pack documents no first-party folder or file-list batch mode and no per-file result reporting. The 'arbitrary number of inputs' and -map stream-selection docs describe feeding multiple inputs into one transcoding graph, which is an adjacent feature, not batch processing. A user's hand-written batch-file wrapper is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.
